name: Pot of Gambling
printed_text: Declare 1 card name; roll a six-sided die, then excavate cards from the top of your deck equal to the result, then add 1 excavated card with the declared name to your hand. If you did not add any card by this effect, you lose 2000 LP.

name: Melville the Crewal Vessel
printed_text: 2+ Level 4 Zombie monsters. If this card is Special Summoned while it has no material: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; attach it to this card as material. While this card has material (Quick Effect): You can detach all materials from this card, then place this card in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Trap; excavate that many cards from the top of your Deck, and if you do, you can add any excavated "Crewal" cards to your hand, then place the rest on the bottom of your Deck. You cannot Special Summon the turn you activate this effect, except Zombie monsters. You can only use each effect of "Melville the Crewal Vessel" once per turn. You can only control 1 "Melville the Crewal Vessel".

name: Sylvan Flamushroomo
printed_text: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can reveal any number of "Sylvan" cards in your hand, then excavate that many cards from the top of your Deck, send any excavated Plant monsters to the GY, also place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. If this card is excavated and sent to the GY by a card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Sylvan" monster from your hand or GY. You can only use this effect of "Sylvan Flamushroomo" once per turn.

name: Sylvan Goleaf
printed_text: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can place 1 "Sylvan" monster from your Deck on the top of your Deck. Once per turn: You can excavate the top card of your Deck, and if it is a Plant monster, send it to the GY, also this card Level becomes that monster Level. Otherwise, place it on the bottom of your Deck. If this card is excavated and sent to the GY by a card effect: You can target 1 "Sylvan" monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use this effect of "Sylvan Goleaf" once per turn.

name: Sylvan Flamioak
printed_text: Once per turn: You can choose a number from 1 to 3, then excavate that many cards from the top of your Deck, send any excavated Plant Type monsters to the GY, also place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. You can only use the following effects of "Sylvan Flamioak" once per turn. If a "Sylvan" monster is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon this card from your hand or GY. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Sylvan" Spell/Trap Card from your Deck or GY to your hand.

name: Sylvan Greetings
printed_text: Excavate the top 5 card of your Deck, then you can add up to 2 excavated "Sylvan" Spell/Trap Cards to your hand also send any excavated Plant monster to the GY and place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. You cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except Plant monsters. You can only use this effect of "Sylvan Greetings" once per turn. If this card is excavated by the effect of a "Sylvan" card, send it to the GY. If this card is sent to the GY by a "Sylvan" card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Sylvan" monster from your hand or GY.

name: Sylvan Intervention
printed_text: Send this card to the GY, then target 3 "Sylvan" monsters in your GY; Place 2 of them on top of your Deck in any order, then Special Summon the other one. You can only use this effect of "Sylvan Intervention" once per turn. If this card is excavated by the effect of a "Sylvan" card, send it to the GY. If a Plant monster(s) you control would be destroyed by a card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead.

name: Sylvan Blast
printed_text: When this card is activated: You can place "Sylvan" monsters from your Deck and/or GY on top of your Deck in any order up to the number of Plant monsters you control with different Attribute. Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 Plant monster you control; excavate cards from the top of your Deck equal to that monster Level/Rank/Link-Rating, send any excavated Plant Type monsters to the GY, also place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. If this card is excavated by the effect of a "Sylvan" card, send it to the GY. You can only activate 1 "Sylvan Blast" per turn.

name: Sylvan Duchessprout
printed_text:
1 "Sylvan" monster
You can only Special Summon "Sylvan Duchessprout" once per turn. If this card is Link Summoned: You can excavate the top 2 cards of your Deck, then send any excavated Plant monsters to the GY, also place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Sylvan" monster you control, and declare a Level from 1 to 8; it becomes that Level.

name: Gink, the Sylvan High Champion
printed_text:
2+ Level 6 monsters
Once per turn: You can add 1 "Sylvan" monster from your Deck to your hand, then excavate the top card of your Deck, and if it is a Plant monster, send it to the GY. Otherwise, place it on the bottom of your Deck. When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or effect (Quick Effect): You can detach any number of material from this card; excavate that many cards from the top of your Deck, then if you excavated a Plant monster, negate that effect and destroy that card, also send that Plant monster to the GY, otherwise, place the excavated cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. You can only use each effect of "Gink, the Sylvan High Champion" once per turn.

name: Skewy! Pumpki-Pal
printed_text: If your opponent controls more monsters than you do, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Reveal the top card of your Deck and if it is a "Skewy!" card, add it to your hand, then if it is a monster you can Special Summon it. Otherwise, send it to the GY. If this card is sent to the GY: You can place 1 Candy Counter on 1 face-up monster your opponent controls. You can only use each effect of "Skewy! Pumpki-Pal" once per turn.

name: Eclipse Observer Chandra
printed_text: 2 Level 8 Spellcaster monsters If your opponent draws 2 or more cards at the same time: You can detach 1 material from this card; excavate that many cards from the top of your Deck and add 2 of them to your hand, then shuffle the rest into the Deck. You can target up to 3 cards in your banishment; shuffle them into your Deck. If this card is sent to the GY: You can send cards your opponent controls to the GY, up to the number of "Eclipse" Quick-Play Spells with different names in your GY, and if you do, your opponent draws cards equal to the number sent. You can only use each effect of "Eclipse Observer Chandra" once per turn.
